remote_script:
set -eu
p=/home/root/xovi/extensions.d/pi-ink-interface-probe.so
stock=b1816408cf90b19e448c70082625c4d6a36060368706eb7a9b35425428a9a021
test ! -e "$p"
test ! -L "$p"
test "$(uname -m)" = aarch64
test "$(sha256sum /usr/bin/xochitl | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$stock"
test "$(systemctl is-active xochitl)" = active
test "$(readlink /home/root/xovi/services/xochitl.service/extensions.d)" = /home/root/xovi/extensions.d
snapshot() {
    sha256sum /usr/bin/xochitl /home/root/xovi/xovi.so /home/root/xovi/start /home/root/xovi/stock
    find /home/root/xovi/extensions.d -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name pi-ink-interface-probe.so -exec sha256sum {} \;
    ls -l /home/root/xovi/extensions.d
    sha256sum /usr/lib/systemd/system/xochitl.service /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/50-computed-widgets-01-preflight.conf /usr/lib/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/xochitl-service-override.conf
    systemctl cat xochitl | sha256sum
    systemctl show xochitl -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths
}
printf 'PRE_SNAPSHOT\n'
snapshot
owned=0
rollback() {
    code=$?
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    set +e
    if test "$owned" = 1; then
        printf 'ROLLBACK_BEGIN\n'
        rm -f -- "$p"
        removal=$?
        timeout 25 systemctl restart xochitl
        restart=$?
        sleep 8
        systemctl is-active xochitl
        active=$?
        test ! -e "$p" && test ! -L "$p"
        absent=$?
        printf 'ROLLBACK_CODES removal=%s restart=%s active=%s absent=%s\n' "$removal" "$restart" "$active" "$absent"
        printf 'POST_SNAPSHOT\n'
        snapshot
        if test "$removal:$restart:$active:$absent" != 0:0:0:0; then exit 91; fi
    fi
    exit "$code"
}
trap rollback EXIT HUP INT TERM
(set -C; : > "$p")
owned=1
cat > "$p"
chmod 0644 "$p"
test "$(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = 5dbdbb85c1767a901d8f0924122f3030d1db316da59dbb727c9eed126fdbabca
printf 'INSTALLED_HASH\n'
sha256sum "$p"
since=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
timeout 25 systemctl restart xochitl
printf 'LOAD_RESTART_RETURNED\n'
sleep 30
systemctl is-active xochitl
printf 'PROBE_METADATA_BEGIN\n'
journalctl -u xochitl --since "$since" --no-pager -o cat --grep '^PI_INK_META_0011_01a19c0f '
printf 'PROBE_METADATA_END\n'
